descriptionChirho: A masculine proper noun referring to Merari, the third son of Levi (Genesis 46:11; Exodus 6:16) and ancestor of the Merarite clan of Levites who served in the tabernacle and temple (Numbers 3-4, 7, 10, 26; Joshua 21; 1 Chronicles 6, 9, 15, 23-24, 26; 2 Chronicles 29, 34; Ezra 8). Multilingual glosses consistently transliterate: English 'Merari,' Spanish 'Merari,' Hindi 'Marari' (मरारी), Arabic 'Marari' (مَرَارِي), Korean 'Meurari' (므라리), Swahili 'Merari.' The two clusters differ only by conjunction waw prefix ('and Merari'), not by referent.
